caption: The drawing features a mechanical or structural component rendered in shades of gray on a beige, slightly textured background. The component has a roughly leaf-shaped or teardrop outline with a series of internal supports forming geometric patterns, divided into various polygonal and triangular sections. At one end, the object has a circular loop integrated into its frame. The drawing presents three different views: a top view, a side elevation, and an isometric perspective. The top view shows the full outline and internal grid clearly, the side elevation displays the flatness and thickness with small supporting legs, and the isometric view presents a three-dimensional sense of the object's thickness and the angle of its supports. There is also a scale indicated beneath the side elevation. The whole image is executed in pencil or graphite with careful attention to linework and shading to highlight form and structure, and there are some small brownish spots and markings on the paper. The artist's signature appears in the lower left corner.
title: Trivet
